faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.desc: Everything you need to know before we kick off. Miss something? Reach out — we reply fast.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Most of our engagements run 6 to 12 weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger platforms can extend to 3-6 months — we scope each one from your goals, not a template.

items.question: Do you work with in-house teams?
items.answer: Yes. We pair well with internal design, product and engineering teams — either leading the work or filling specific gaps. We scale in or out based on what you actually need.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: Fixed-fee by project or monthly retainer. You get a line-item proposal after the discovery call — no hidden hours, no surprise change orders.

items.question: Who owns the work once it ships?
items.answer: You do. Full source, assets, accounts and documentation transfer on delivery. We will happily stay on for maintenance, but we do not hold your work hostage.

items.question: Do you do just design, or also build?
items.answer: Both. Strategy, brand, product design and production engineering (web, Shopify, headless CMS, Nuxt, Next). Most clients hire us for the full loop.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Montreal, working with clients globally. Async-first, with weekly syncs in your timezone.
